**Company:** Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd. (Private limited company, incorporated 1991‑12‑07) is an active education company based in Selangor that operates private kindergartens and daycares in Johor Bahru. Its share capital is RM2.50m.

**Director & Shareholder:** The board consists of 2 directors and the company has 2 shareholders. The largest shareholder is Director 1, holding 51.02 % of the shares.

**Financials:** For FY 2024 the company posted revenue of RM5.61m, a 36.7 % increase over FY 2023. Gross profit margin rose to 54.1 % and operating profit margin to 11.7 %. Free cash flow amounted to RM357.9k, while net debt (borrowings – cash) stood at RM1.95m. The figures suggest strong top‑line growth, solid profitability and positive cash generation, though the company remains net‑leveraged.

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.

**Review Rating:** **5/5 — Very high review priority**. Robust revenue growth, improving margins, healthy cash flow and an absence of material defendant litigation justify a high‑priority review.

It operates in the Retail industry in Sarawak, specialising in the sale of textiles and baju kurung. Share capital amounts to RM5.00m.

**Director & Shareholder:** The company has 3 directors and 3 shareholders. Director 2 is the largest shareholder, holding 45.57% of the shares.

**Financials:** No financial statements are recorded for the most recent fiscal year, so revenue growth, margin analysis, free cash flow, and net debt cannot be assessed.

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.

**Review Rating:** 3/5 — Moderate review priority: The absence of financial data limits confidence, yet no material defendant litigation or other adverse signals are evident.

**Company:** Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. (formerly known as Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd.) – a private limited company incorporated on 1995‑08‑28, currently active in Kuala Lumpur. The business operates cafés and coffee shops in Penang under the Food & Beverage industry, with a share capital of RM500.0k.

**Director & Shareholder:** The board consists of 5 directors and there are 4 shareholders. The largest shareholder is Director 1, owning 50.59 % of the shares.

**Financials:** In the latest year 2024, revenue fell by -7.4 % from RM2249.8k to RM2084.0k. Gross profit margin contracted to 52.0 % (RM1084.5k) while operating profit margin slumped to -11.2 % (RM‑232.29k). Free cash flow was negative at RM‑205.75k and net debt stood at RM659.2k, indicating a deteriorating cash generation profile and growing leverage.

**Litigation:** Two court cases were recorded. As defendant, the company faced one debt‑recovery suit (claim RM106.9k) which was dismissed. As plaintiff, it pursued one debt‑recovery claim (claim RM519.8k) that was settled. The overall status of the cases is Dismissed and Settled.

**Review Rating:** 2/5 – *High‑risk review priority.* The company is active but shows declining sales, negative operating and free cash flows, and a growing net debt position, while also having material defendant litigation.

**Company:** Cahaya Golden Systems Sdn. Bhd. (Private limited company, incorporated 2019‑09‑29, currently winding up) operates in the Technology sector in Selangor, providing software development for small‑business accounting. Its share capital is RM2.50m.

**Director & Shareholder:** Three directors and three shareholders are recorded. The largest shareholder is Director 2, holding 52.17 % of the shares.

**Financials:** In FY 2024 revenue rose 2.5 % YoY to RM13.01m, with a gross profit margin of 60.8 % and an operating profit margin of 14.8 %. Free cash flow fell to RM614.7k, while net debt increased to RM2.33m, indicating a shift from earlier positive cash generation.

**Litigation:** Eight defendant cases are on record, totalling RM6.82m in claim amounts. Four cases remain pending, one dismissed, one withdrawn, one judged, and one settled.

**Review Rating:** 1/5 — Very low review priority; the winding‑up status overrides other considerations, so further vetting is not a priority.

**Company:** Teguh Bestari Medical Sdn. Bhd. – a private limited company incorporated on 17 Oct 1988, currently active in Sabah’s healthcare sector as a dental clinic and orthodontic services provider. The company’s share capital stands at RM100.0k and its total equity is RM614.0k.

**Director & Shareholder:** The board consists of two directors, and the shareholding structure is held by two individuals. Director 1 holds the largest stake of 63.91 % and Director 2 holds 36.09 %.

**Financials:** In 2024 the company posted RM1.16m in revenue, up 6.4 % from RM1.09m the previous year. Gross profit margin fell slightly to 42.5 % and operating profit margin settled at 12.5 %. Free cash flow was RM144.6k, while net debt (borrowings – cash) was RM411.8k. Overall, revenue and margin trends are stable and cash generation remains positive.

**Litigation:** Six court cases are recorded: one as defendant (claim RM310.6k) and five as plaintiff (total claim RM4.92m). Case outcomes include 3 judgments entered, 1 pending, 1 withdrawn, and 1 dismissed.

**Review Rating:** 4 / 5 – High review priority. The firm shows consistent growth, healthy cash flow, and no material defendant litigation, but its moderate net debt warrants further assessment.

**Company:** Mutiara Delima Agro Sdn. Bhd. (formerly known as Sejahtera Resources Sdn. It operates in oil palm plantation and fresh fruit bunch supply, with a share capital of **RM250.0k**.

**Director & Shareholder:** The board consists of **four directors** and **three shareholders**. The largest shareholder is **Director 3**, who holds **58.92 %** of the shares.

**Financials:** The latest audited year is 2024, with a revenue of **RM74.30m**. Gross profit margin is **21.1 %** and operating profit margin is **‑3.4 %**. Free cash flow stands at **‑RM6.60m**, and net debt (borrowings minus cash) is **RM9.80m**. Revenue growth could not be assessed due to missing prior‑year data. Overall, margins are modest, operating cash flow is negative, and the company carries a positive net debt position.

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.

**Review Rating:** 2/5 — **Low review priority**: The firm exhibits negative operating and cash‑flow metrics and carries net debt, prompting a cautious review despite its active status and absence of defendant litigation.

**Company:** Kirana Everbright Packaging Sdn. Bhd. (Private limited company) was incorporated on 26 Nov 2005 in Sarawak, Malaysia. The company is currently active and operates in the manufacturing industry, specialising in the production of plastic packaging for food products. Its share capital is RM2.50m.

**Director & Shareholder:** The board comprises 4 directors. The company has 1 shareholder, Sejahtera Holdings Sdn. Bhd., holding 100.00 % of the shares.

**Financials:** In FY 2024 revenue fell by 20.3 % from RM30.35m to RM24.21m, with a gross profit margin of 23.3 % and an operating profit margin of 2.3 %. Free cash flow was RM101.5k, while net debt stood at RM1.59m (borrowings RM3.65m minus cash RM2.05m). The firm shows declining top‑line growth and thin operating profitability, yet it remains cash‑generating and has modest net debt.

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.

**Review Rating:** 4/5 – High review priority: revenue decline and low operating margin are notable concerns, but the company remains cash‑positive and has no defendant litigation to offset the risks.
